verdict_reason: Mack (1984) Fig 10.4 max FIRST-mode temporal omega_i vs R at M=4.5, adiabatic. The high-Mach first mode is OBLIQUE-dominated, so growth is maximized over BOTH alpha and wave angle psi (peak psi~60 deg, first-mode phase speed c_r~0.83, distinct from the 2D second mode c_r~0.9 of Fig 10.6). Domain-converged: y_max=42 ~4x delta*/L*=10.3 (a short box starves the thick BL and spuriously under-predicts the mode -- the Fig 10.6 domain lesson). pyMack omega_i,max(R) vs the digitized paper curve: median relative error 6.9% (mean 10.2%, max 29.5%) over 12 positive-growth overlapping R-stations (L* scale, 3D temporal first mode, N=130, y_max=42). A bounded residual offset above the 5% floor; the oblique first mode tracks Mack's rising-then-plateauing curve across the band. CONFIDENCE NOTE: computed with solve_temporal_compressible_3d (reduced dense EVP) and max over (alpha,psi), NOT the exact-shooting path used for the convergence-checked Mack 10.3 self-seed cases. The 10.3 agent found the reduced EVP can under-predict or spuriously kill the first mode at some conditions, and no exact-shooting cross-check or explicit y_max/N convergence test was recorded here. Domain was set to ~4x delta*/L* (the second-mode-calibrated rule; the first mode reaches further from the wall and may want more). So the disagree DIRECTION (first-mode under-amplification, consistent with all other first-mode cases) is robust, but the MAGNITUDE and the monotonic-with-Mach trend are LOWER-CONFIDENCE than the 10.3/10.1 first-mode results.
